prepare_birthing_bed.title: Prepare birthing bed
prepare_birthing_bed.caption: On the bed’s right rail, count the four buttons from the foot of the bed toward the head. Press the first to raise the bed fully, the third to raise the backrest fully, the fourth to return the backrest to flat, and the second to lower the bed to its starting height. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown. The MuJoCo recording shows the bed and its controls. The pillow and sheet are modeled in Genesis and are omitted from this recording.

access_warmer_storage.title: Access warmer storage
access_warmer_storage.caption: Face the drawer beneath the newborn warmer’s bassinet and heat lamp. Press the left foot pedal to raise the warmer, pull the drawer containing two supply boxes fully open, then close it. Press the right pedal to lower the warmer, keeping the boxes in place. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

prepare_monitor_cart.title: Prepare monitor cart
prepare_monitor_cart.caption: At the cart with two stacked displays beside the head of the bed, pull the top drawer fully open. From the drawer side, tilt the upper display toward you, then close the drawer all the way. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

adjust_shower.title: Adjust shower
adjust_shower.caption: Fold the bathroom shower’s wall-mounted seat up against the wall. Slide the handheld shower head to the top of its rail, then fold the seat back down to its horizontal position. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

bathroom_call_access.title: Bathroom call access
bathroom_call_access.caption: Slide the bathroom door fully closed. Pull down on the low handle of the nurse-call rope between the toilet and the shower, release it so it returns to rest, then slide the door fully open again. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

adjust_overbed_table.title: Adjust overbed table
adjust_overbed_table.caption: On the wheeled overbed table with a cup on top, press and hold the release lever under the tabletop near its support column. Raise the tabletop fully, then let go of the lever so the top stays locked at the raised height. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

reposition_swaddle.title: Reposition the swaddle
reposition_swaddle.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Lift the swaddle blanket lying on the bassinet mattress beneath the heat lamp. Draw it toward the foot of the bassinet and release it on the mattress, spread over at least 60% of the mattress length.

retrieve_towel.title: Retrieve the towel
retrieve_towel.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Lift the folded towel off the lower of the two bathroom shelves above the towel rack. Unfold it and hold it out in front of the shelf so the whole towel hangs freely.
